name_zh: 原点生活服务站 1:1 公共原型
name_en: Origin Life Service Station 1:1 Public Prototype
concept_location: 北京 AI 原点社区内的概念选点，真实场地与运营主体待确认

spatial_moments.description_en: No digital condition; continuous public movement and rest.
Visible human help, printed information and telephone referral.
Optional bounded task with explicit consent and immediate staffed transfer.
Non-personal service, maintenance and appeal notices.
Low-stimulation garden and ordinary-service restoration end state.

required_inputs: 场地书面同意与消防、结构、无障碍专项复核
服务目录、纸质替代路线与人工排班
十二个场景的数据上限、申诉和停止脚本
可逆构件清单、拆除方法与恢复基线照片

proposed_raci.accountable: 公共服务委托方，真实主体待确认
proposed_raci.responsible: 现场值守与场地管理联合角色，真实主体待确认

physical_stop_action: 断开 AI 服务路径
保留普通通行和人工服务
data_expiry_owner: 公共服务责任角色，真实主体待确认
non_commitment: 概念建议；非官方红线、非审批、非采购或实施承诺。

components.dimension_or_range: continuous segment; final clearances pending professional verification
components.maintenance_daily: check clear passage, shade condition and cane-detectable edge
components.maintenance_monthly: inspect anchors, fabric and surface protection
components.removal_tool: hand tools and approved anchor-release kit
components.reuse_route: inspect, catalogue and reuse in an authorized future reversible kit
components.restoration_acceptance: remove shade unit; restore and photograph surface; verify ordinary passage

components.dimension_or_range: seat and companion-space arrangement; final layout pending accessibility review
components.maintenance_daily: clean seating and keep adjacent wheelchair companion space clear
components.maintenance_monthly: check fixings, arm support and surface wear
components.reuse_route: inspect and redeploy as public seating after authorization
components.restoration_acceptance: remove seating and baseplate; repair surface; verify clear route

components.dimension_or_range: modular care/waiting bay; final turning and transfer clearances pending review
components.maintenance_daily: check privacy option, step-free approach and caregiver adjacency
components.maintenance_monthly: inspect cassette joints and wear surfaces
components.data_boundary: no biometric or health record by default
components.removal_tool: cassette lift handles and hand tools
components.reuse_route: inspect and reuse as a non-digital care/waiting module
components.restoration_acceptance: lift cassette; restore finish; verify ordinary public-service use

components.dimension_or_range: three-layer sign rail; final type size and tactile detail pending verification
components.maintenance_monthly: review content, contrast and tactile attachment condition
components.removal_tool: rail release key and hand tools
components.reuse_route: archive approved content and reuse rail for ordinary wayfinding
components.restoration_acceptance: remove rail; patch interface; retain only cleared ordinary-service signage

components.dimension_or_range: mobile staffed desk with seated service position; final counter geometry pending review
components.install_interface: mobile powered desk with dry connector
components.maintenance_daily: open staffed route, test telephone referral and check clear approach
components.maintenance_monthly: review rota, cable protection and service-log minimisation
components.removal_tool: locking caster release and dry power disconnect
components.reuse_route: retain as ordinary staffed public-service desk
components.restoration_acceptance: disconnect power, remove desk or retain as ordinary service; verify no digital dependency

components.dimension_or_range: low-height interaction point; final reach range pending accessibility review
components.install_interface: reversible mount and isolated data connector
components.maintenance_daily: check keyboard, audio alternative and staffed transfer notice
components.maintenance_monthly: review content, device condition and opt-in notice
components.removal_tool: mount-release key and isolated data disconnect
components.reuse_route: return device to supplier or convert mount to non-digital information panel
components.restoration_acceptance: disconnect data and power; remove device; preserve staffed and printed route

components.dimension_or_range: lockable temporary event-power point; final load and cable design pending review
components.install_interface: lockable temporary point with dry connection
components.maintenance_daily: check cable protection and clear manoeuvring space before use
components.maintenance_monthly: inspect enclosure, connector and isolation label
components.removal_tool: qualified electrical isolation and enclosure-release tools
components.reuse_route: retain for authorized temporary public events or return to supplier
components.restoration_acceptance: qualified isolation, remove temporary point and restore protective finish

components.dimension_or_range: time-limited sensor/data interface outside required clear path
components.install_interface: time-limited mount with isolated power/data connector
components.maintenance_daily: check posted purpose, expiry date and no obstruction
components.maintenance_monthly: review calibration, retention and removal record
components.data_boundary: non-identifying sensing preferred; purpose and retention posted
components.removal_tool: mount-release key plus isolated power/data shutdown
components.reuse_route: return to supplier or retain only after separate authorized review
components.restoration_acceptance: shut down, export or delete per authorized record, remove interface and restore surface
